dependencies.instrument: Directive 2004/38/EC on the right of citizens of the Union and their family members to move and reside freely
dependencies.relationship: Principal EU framework for entry, residence, family-member status, residence documents, retention, permanent residence and equal treatment.
dependencies.review_state: The current consolidated Polish Act and official guidance are identified. The full crosswalk for Articles 5-7, 10-11, 14, 16-18, 24 and 31, including refusals and remedies, remains incomplete.

dependencies.instrument: Agreement on the European Economic Area
dependencies.relationship: Separate treaty basis for Icelandic, Liechtenstein and Norwegian nationals and qualifying family members.
dependencies.review_state: Polish guidance groups EEA EFTA nationals with EU cases operationally. Treaty incorporation, scope and any separate limits are not mapped provision by provision.

dependencies.instrument: Agreement between the European Community and its Member States and the Swiss Confederation on the free movement of persons
dependencies.relationship: Provides a distinct Swiss route; Switzerland is not an EU or EEA EFTA state and its route should not be assumed identical to Directive 2004/38.
dependencies.review_state: The operational Polish guidance groups Swiss cases with EU/EEA cases. Exact treaty and family-member consequences remain to be mapped.

dependencies.instrument: Agreement on the withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the European Union and the European Atomic Energy Community
dependencies.relationship: Separate protected status for qualifying Withdrawal Agreement beneficiaries; it is not a current general free-movement route for new UK arrivals.
dependencies.review_state: Official UDSC guidance and forms are linked. Beneficiary dates, family scope, document rules and appeal routes still need their own crosswalk.

dependencies.instrument: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas
dependencies.relationship: General Schengen short-stay visa procedure; family-member facilitation under Directive 2004/38 is a distinct route and must not be collapsed into ordinary visa processing.
dependencies.review_state: MFA visa guidance and mission discovery links are accepted within scope. The exact appointment, fee/service-provider route must be checked for the applicant's country and mission.

dependencies.instrument: Act of 14 July 2006 on entry into, residence in and departure from Poland by EU Member State citizens and their family members; consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1065
dependencies.relationship: Core national implementation of free-movement entry, registration, family-member cards, residence and permanent residence.
dependencies.status_evidence: ELI displayed obowiązujący and legal-status date 23 July 2026 when checked 21 October 2026. The 2025 amending Act Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1794 has staged commencement.
dependencies.review_state: Official link accepted. Map each procedural or substantive issue to the relevant section and check the 2025 amendment only where its staged commencement affects that provision. No full Gazette chain is required for ordinary link use.

dependencies.instrument: Act of 12 December 2013 on Foreigners, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1079
dependencies.relationship: Governs national immigration routes distinct from EU-citizen registration and EU-family residence cards, including visa, entry and national-permit questions.
dependencies.review_state: ELI showed the 2025 consolidated announcement as in force but listed two later amendments. Use it within its cutoff and check a later change only for a provision material to the issue. The 2025/1794 staged amendments require targeted application to affected matters.

dependencies.instrument: Code of Administrative Procedure, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1691
dependencies.relationship: General rules for administrative decisions, participation, evidence, service, complaints and petitions; special immigration statutes may modify the route.
dependencies.review_state: Link accepted as the official consolidated text. Build a decision-specific crosswalk for the administrative authority, appeal, deadline, service, suspension/interim measures and judicial review. A complaint or petition under Division VIII is not an appeal.

dependencies.instrument: Council of Ministers Regulation of 8 January 2002 on the organisation of receiving and considering complaints and petitions, Dz.U. 2002 poz. 46
dependencies.relationship: Implements the KPA complaints and petitions procedure described by UDSC.
dependencies.review_state: ELI displayed status obowiązujący. Keep complaints and petitions separate from the appeal against a specific decision and from the complaint about delay in that case.

dependencies.instrument: Law on Proceedings Before Administrative Courts, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2026 poz. 143
dependencies.relationship: Governs judicial review of administrative decisions and omissions, subject to admissibility and special-law rules.
dependencies.review_state: Official link accepted, with one later amendment noted by ELI. The route, prior administrative appeal, filing period, fee, interim relief and review scope must be mapped for each decision type. NSA search is not proof of complete precedent coverage.

dependencies.instrument: Act of 18 November 2020 on Electronic Delivery, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2026 poz. 3
dependencies.relationship: Sets the general electronic-delivery framework from 1 January 2026, subject to statutory exceptions and specific procedures.
dependencies.review_state: ELI displayed status obowiązujący and one amendment after the consolidated text. UDSC says individual ePUAP submissions after 1 January 2026 are ineffective for its general complaint route; UODO SIS guidance still instructs ePUAP use. Resolve the exact national and EU special-law basis before publishing any channel as effective. Do not apply a universal ePUAP rule.

dependencies.instrument: Act on Poland's participation in the Schengen Information System and Visa Information System, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1061
dependencies.relationship: National allocation of competent authorities and data-subject procedures for SIS/VIS, including the Police role described by UODO.
dependencies.status_evidence: ELI displayed status obowiązujący, announcement dated 31 July 2026, publication date 6 August 2026 and legal-status date 20 July 2026.
dependencies.review_state: Current consolidated link identified and accepted. Crosswalk the Police and UODO procedure, the exact request and remedy, e-delivery, and any special channel exception.

dependencies.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2018/1861 on SIS in the field of border checks
dependencies.relationship: Directly applicable SIS framework including information, access, rectification, erasure and judicial remedies for data subjects; see in particular Articles 52-54.
dependencies.review_state: Official EUR-Lex current version is dated 3 August 2021 and shows the act has been changed. Identify which alert and authority fall under this Regulation rather than assuming every SIS file does.

dependencies.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2018/1862 on SIS in the field of police cooperation and judicial cooperation in criminal matters
dependencies.relationship: Separate SIS instrument for police/judicial alerts and related data-subject rights and remedies.
dependencies.review_state: Map the data category and responsible controller before applying the border-checks regulation or the national guidance.

dependencies.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation)
dependencies.relationship: General data-protection rights and supervisory framework; law-enforcement processing may instead fall under Directive (EU) 2016/680 and special SIS rules.
dependencies.review_state: Keep ordinary administrative data, SIS data and law-enforcement processing distinct. Link acceptance does not decide which regime governs a particular request.

dependencies.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2019/1157, invalidated by the Court of Justice in C-61/22, with effects maintained pending replacement
dependencies.relationship: Historical residence-document security regime; C-61/22 invalidated it but maintained its effects pending a replacement regulation.
dependencies.review_state: Do not present Regulation 2019/1157 as the current standalone rule. Compare the cited Polish form regulations and transition notice with the successor Regulation (EU) 2025/1208.

dependencies.instrument: Council Regulation (EU) 2025/1208 on identity cards and residence documents for free movement
dependencies.relationship: Article 6 sets minimum data for EU-citizen residence documents; Article 7 sets the uniform format and annotations for residence cards of non-EU family members; Article 8 phases out some existing residence cards.
dependencies.review_state: The 3 August 2026 transition date has passed. Article 8 applies to the non-EU-family residence cards in its scope and contains exceptions; do not apply the date indiscriminately to all EU-citizen residence documents. Visually verify the current Polish specimen and reconcile it with the two national forms regulations.

dependencies.instrument: MSWiA regulations on applications and documents for EU-citizen residence (Dz.U. 2021 poz. 1392) and permanent residence (Dz.U. 2021 poz. 1391)
dependencies.relationship: The two regulations separately prescribe application forms, required documents, certificates/cards and specimens for residence and permanent-residence routes.
dependencies.review_state: Both current official links are accepted. Match each form and specimen to its legal category and verify the current displayed attachment before use; the 2021 transition page alone is not a current form source.

dependencies.instrument: Stamp Duty Act, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1154
dependencies.relationship: National statutory fee source relevant to administrative filings and any applicable exemptions.
dependencies.review_state: ELI displayed four later amendments after the consolidation. A fee schedule must be cross-checked against current form and procedure rules; do not infer the residence-card production fee from the stamp-duty Act alone.

dependencies.instrument: Act on free legal aid, civic counselling and legal education, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2026 poz. 44
dependencies.relationship: General public legal-aid framework; asylum-specific representation is a separate statutory and administrative lane.
dependencies.review_state: Current consolidated text is accepted as a link. Establish whether eligibility and service scope extend to the specific EU-family, appeal or court procedure; the source count alone does not answer that question.

dependencies.instrument: Constitution of the Republic of Poland, Dz.U. 1997 nr 78 poz. 483
dependencies.relationship: Constitutional framework for court access, two-instance proceedings, public-authority liability and oversight. It must be read with procedural legislation.
dependencies.review_state: Official link accepted. Map the constitutional principles to the route and remedy provided by the applicable statute; no constitutional complaint or damages pathway is completed here.

dependencies.instrument: Act on the Commissioner for Human Rights, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1264
dependencies.relationship: Defines the Ombudsman's statutory role in protecting rights and investigating public-authority conduct or omissions.
dependencies.review_state: Statutory oversight is distinct from appeals, judicial remedies and ordinary complaints to the administration. Review how an RPO submission relates to the relevant deadline and procedure.

dependencies.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2016/1191 on public documents
dependencies.relationship: Can simplify presentation of certain public documents between EU Member States and restrict apostille requirements for covered documents.
dependencies.review_state: Check the document type, issuing EU Member State, multilingual form, translation and exceptions before relying on general apostille guidance.

dependencies.instrument: Access to Public Information Act, consolidated announcement Dz.U. 2022 poz. 902
dependencies.relationship: Public access route to records, distinct from an individual case-file inspection request and a merits appeal.
dependencies.review_state: One later amendment is noted in ELI. Use the consolidated link within its cutoff and check that amendment if it may affect the requested information or deadline.
